This is third application filed by applicant under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No. 179/2022, registered at Police Station-Kumhari, District Damoh (MP) for the offence punishable under Sections 354, 354(D), 342, 376, 376(D)(A), 506, 34 of Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4, 7/8 and 11/12 of Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act.

1 statement, she has not made any allegation against applicant, but, in second statement allegations are made that applicant had committed rape on her.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is submitted that prosecutrix is aged about 15 years and 6 months.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State as well as counsel appearing for objector opposed the bail application and submitted that prosecutrix is minor.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Considering first and second statement of prosecutrix recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

6. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court.

7. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
8.
